# Oregon School Boards Association

> OSBA is Oregon's premier membership organization serving school board members with professional development, legal resources, policy advocacy, and equity-focused leadership programs.

The Oregon School Boards Association (OSBA) represents over 1,400 school board members across Oregon, providing governance support, legislative advocacy, legal assistance, and professional development services. OSBA operates through specialized committees and advisory groups focused on equity, rural schools, and LGBTQIA2S+ inclusion.

## Key Topics

- Oregon School Boards Association (OSBA)
- Board Development & Leadership Training

## Professional Development & Board Training

- [Board Development Services | Oregon School Boards Association](https://www.osba.org/board-development): Board development, leadership training, and certification programs
- [Oregon School Board Member of the Year - osba.org](https://www.osba.org/oregon-school-board-member-of-the-year): Annual award nomination for outstanding school board members

## Legal Services & Professional Networks

- [Legal Assistance Trust | Oregon School Boards Association](https://www.osba.org/legal-assistance-trust): Legal Assistance Trust litigation funding and appellate support program
- [Council of School Attorneys | Oregon School Boards Association](https://www.osba.org/council-of-school-attorneys): COSA professional network and legal resources for school attorneys

## Policy Advocacy & Legislative Services

- [Legislative Policy Committee | Oregon School Boards Association](https://www.osba.org/legislative-policy-committee): Legislative Policy Committee shaping Oregon education policy advocacy

## Equity & Inclusion Committees

- [Oregon School Board Members of Color Caucus | Oregon School Boards Association](https://www.osba.org/oregon-school-board-members-of-color-caucus): Caucus promoting education equity for students of color

- [Oregon Rural School Boards Advisory Committee | Oregon School Boards Association](https://www.osba.org/oregon-rural-school-boards-advisory-committee): Rural School Boards Advisory Committee resources and governance
